from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentInfo(BaseModel):
    """Information extracted from a single legal document."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title or name of the document as labeled (e.g., '判决文书 10')")
    document_type: str | None = Field(description="The type of legal instrument (e.g., '判决书', '裁定书', '通知书')")
    case_cause_or_charge: str | None = Field(description="The cause of action or criminal charge identified in the document (e.g., '渎职罪', '玩忽职守罪', '行政诉讼')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentInfo]
